name: Sara
source:
The mysterious person amongst the whole mystery surrounding the mansion. Doesn’t come out of her room so the younglings think she is a vampire. She seems to still go for toilet breaks and eats her food (brought to her door by [url=/c686]Haina[/url]) though.

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
